name: rsearch
description: Research you can inspect: source-linked dossiers using native Codex or Claude, with retrieval gates and explicit evidence levels.

interface.longDescription: Turn a focused question into a source-linked report with explicit evidence levels, visible gaps and a record of research activity. Choose native Codex or Claude. Install and authenticate the selected provider CLI before researching.
defaultPrompt: Research this question and show me its sources, evidence levels and gaps.
